governance.root_cause_repair_policy: Maximum 2 root-cause repairs per defect class. Legal fallback authorized under plan-source/families/F5.md line 47: '先规则/单波有限事件，再波包；主范围可比复杂地形更简单，但必须包含爬升/越堤真实事件。'
governance.rootguard_execution_policy: All actual motion/STL/CSV/scientific generation, GenCase/solver/data evaluation strictly Rootguard only; synthetic fixtures allowed, no actual dataset generation.
governance.claim: none; prospective source code and compact physical specification only, no outcomes claimed from source

continuous_bed.surface_first_boundary_support: Root024 52-triangle rasterization prior to solid wall/piston boxes

weir_structure.description: Low crest weir on slope with central notch allowing candidate shallow overtopping into upper slope and receiving basin while lateral shoulders retain and reflect downslope fluid.

mechanisms.background_name: Sloping Bed Runup, Breaking, and Return Flow
mechanisms.physical_description: Finite single-wave packet generated by prescribed compact paddle motion climbs continuous sloping bed (m = 0.280), undergoes shoaling, reaches peak runup excursion on slope, breaks, and undergoes downslope drawdown back into basin with paddle stationary.
mechanisms.assertion_policy: No assertion of eliminating chaos; finite packet provides clean, isolated incident event and unforced return flow window.

mechanisms.background_name: Notched Weir Overtopping and Receiving Basin Retention
mechanisms.physical_description: Finite single-wave packet encounters low notched weir on slope. Candidate overtopping cohort spills through central notch toward receiving basin; retained cohort reflects downslope.
mechanisms.assertion_policy: No assertion of actual overtopping from packet; treated strictly as candidate hydrodynamic mechanism.

resolutions_ladder.comparison_policy: Independent reference ladder .02/.0125/.01 is direct unequal-r comparisons, not Richardson assumption.

observer_specification.geometry_policy: Probes local bed true elevation: point0.z = z_bed(x) to prevent sub-bed embedding and false 1.5H floor step jumps.

control.rationale: Finite wave packet isolates incident wave propagation and runup from continuous wavemaker pumping, leaving a 11.0 s quiescent tail for natural return flow and settling.

resource_estimates.comparison_to_rejected_042: Rejected 042 fine pair alone demanded 12.0 GPUh. Compact configuration reduces fine pair to ~1.8 GPUh (~6.7x reduction), fitting easily in remaining 29.3 GPUh campaign reserve.
